landmarks.anatomy: Distal radial styloid bordering radiocarpal interval

modelIndicator.construction: Native distal styloid facet is observed; model interval uses independent scaphoid facet.
limitations: No wrist skin crease or pulsatile radial artery represented; static structural approximation.
